# Digital Kings

> Engineering-grade AI automation, digital marketing, and custom web development — built by a software engineer with 10 years of experience.

Digital Kings is a digital growth agency founded by a software engineer with a decade of experience building production systems. Unlike traditional marketing agencies, every service is built on engineering principles: systematic, measurable, and automated where possible.

## Services

- **AI Automation**: Custom n8n workflows, LLM integrations, CRM automation, and intelligent lead systems
- **Digital Marketing**: Paid advertising (Google Ads, Meta Ads), SEO, email campaigns, and analytics
- **Custom Web Development**: Full-stack Next.js websites — no templates, no page builders
- **Social Media Management**: Strategy, content, and data-driven optimisation

## Why Digital Kings

The founder spent 10 years building software systems — architectures, automation pipelines, and full-stack applications. That engineering mindset applies directly to marketing: every campaign is a system, every decision is data-driven, and every client gets direct access to the person doing the work.

## Service Areas

Digital Kings serves businesses across Washington state, with a focus on the Seattle metro area and Puget Sound region. Local SEO, geo-targeted paid advertising, and AI automation are available for all of the following cities:

- **Bellevue, WA** — Tech hub, Microsoft/Amazon spillover, SaaS companies, financial services, luxury retail. Page: https://digikings.net/locations/bellevue-wa
- **Redmond, WA** — Microsoft HQ, gaming studios, SaaS startups, tech consultancies. Page: https://digikings.net/locations/redmond-wa
- **Issaquah, WA** — Costco HQ, growing suburb, outdoor/retail/lifestyle, local professional services. Page: https://digikings.net/locations/issaquah-wa
- **Renton, WA** — Boeing, aerospace suppliers, healthcare, logistics, diverse industries. Page: https://digikings.net/locations/renton-wa
- **Kent, WA** — Industrial backbone, manufacturing, warehousing, distribution, B2B wholesale. Page: https://digikings.net/locations/kent-wa
- **Auburn, WA** — Fast-growing retail corridor, auto dealers, home services, healthcare practices. Page: https://digikings.net/locations/auburn-wa
- **Federal Way, WA** — Diverse city between Seattle and Tacoma, healthcare, retail, legal services. Page: https://digikings.net/locations/federal-way-wa
- **Tacoma, WA** — Port city, manufacturing, healthcare systems, arts and hospitality. Page: https://digikings.net/locations/tacoma-wa
- **Sammamish, WA** — Affluent suburb, tech workers, wealth management, medical practices, professional services. Page: https://digikings.net/locations/sammamish-wa

Locations index: https://digikings.net/locations
